steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Ensure terms are not pre-selected as mandatory before the buyer marks all terms mandatory.
Enable the eRFX/sourcing creation flow used by the test company.
Allow the buyer to add the QA vendor during event creation.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Provide the required event title.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add the specified product and requested quantity.
Set the requested delivery location in the pricing sheet.

args.goal: open Terms & Conditions on the single-stage RFQ create screen, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", enable "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory" so both clauses show they are overridden by the mandatory setting, click Done, and stop on the create screen

steps.note: Configure the two event terms and the mark-all-mandatory behavior, which has no dedicated domain step.
Commit the 30-minute schedule required before publishing.
Add one QA test vendor to the event.
Publish the configured RFQ.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal session.
Open the event's RFQ bid sheet as the vendor.
Confirm the first clause is visible to the vendor.
Confirm the second clause is visible to the vendor.
Accept exactly one of the two mandatory clauses.
Attempt to quote 100 and submit while the second mandatory clause remains unaccepted; submission must be blocked.
